items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: And this man was Dave Poikins, the first trombone player in the French Opera House, if I'm all right? No, Tulane Theater.

ctx.x: Roy brought me a horn. I shined the horn up, cleaned the horn. About an hour after I cleaned the horn and was sitting down in the back. There wasn't much during that night and my knee wasn't there. I didn't use him until late at night anyway. Roy come in. And I said, yeah, man, I'm pulling with this thing. I'm going to play it. And he showed me then how to blow and how to play on the instrument, see. But it seemed like I had so much ambition I didn't want even Roy to show me I liked the trumpet because my father…
He played with the white musicians too, right?
